name: Shirakawa Kyouko
source:
Bright, cheerful, and selfish. The terrifying eldest of the Shirakawa sisters, she continuously teases her adorable little brother to the core.

She is a merciless older sister when it comes to teasing, having enjoyed playing naughty games with Yu since they were little.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/sp/soft.phtml?id=209081&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
